steps.code:
records = re.findall(r'(?m)^TX-\S+.*$', context)
matched = []
for line in records:
    if re.search(r'\bregion=EMEA\b', line) and re.search(r'\bstatus=SETTLED\b', line):
        tx_id = re.search(r'^(TX-\S+)', line).group(1)
        amount = int(re.search(r'\bamount_cents=(\d+)', line).group(1))
        matched.append((tx_id, amount))
print("count=", len(matched), "total=", sum(a for _, a in matched), "max=", max(matched, key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0])) if matched else None)
print(matched)
